repo_purpose: Offline-first Python CLI for scanning, classifying, and recovering damaged visual media with SQLite evidence tracking, JPEG-focused repair strategies, baseline image/video carving, optional FFmpeg-assisted salvage, and JSON/CSV reporting.

source_areas.role: CLI parser, command arguments, command dispatch, run startup, summary printing
scan, classify, recover, score, write outputs, and persist recovery evidence
input file iteration, byte reads, hashes, declared kind, and file records
family, label, confidence, and classification evidence
candidate generation engines including jpeg-v1 and baseline-v2
Pillow and FFmpeg/ffprobe probing, saving, remuxing, previews, frames, and output hashes
SQLite schema, migrations, persistence, summaries, and attempts rows
JSON summary and attempts CSV export
local workspace layout and config snapshots
historical source evidence, not current behavior authority

test_areas.coverage: JPEG classification labels for missing EOI and missing SOI with internal structure
anywhere signature detection for prefixed MP4 data
run summary counts, duplicate candidate persistence, and successful image output summaries
JPEG recovery strategies, candidate generation, standard color tables, and FFmpeg-gated prefixed MP4 recovery

safety_rules: Preserve existing runtime behavior unless explicitly asked to change it.
Do not edit source, tests, package metadata, release archives, deployment config, cloud/account settings, encryption setup, or secrets during docs-only work.
Do not commit, push, deploy, publish, tag, release, reset, stash, or discard changes unless explicitly asked.
Treat source, package config, and tests as higher-priority truth than docs and historical reports.
Do not invent project history, architecture, security guarantees, workflows, deployment support, roadmap items, or decisions.
Record exact blockers when validation cannot be run.
sensitive_path_rules: Do not include secrets, credentials, private keys, tokens, private certificates, account IDs, private URLs, private media paths, or .env contents in docs.
Keep machine-specific absolute paths out of repo docs and JSON indexes.
Keep .agents/ and .specify/ local-only unless a future explicit decision changes that.
Do not treat generated recovery outputs, SQLite databases, JSON reports, CSV reports, or raw candidates as anonymized public artifacts.

obsidian_conventions.wiki_links: allowed sparingly in hub notes for Obsidian graph navigation

known_risks: The worktree may contain unrelated dirty release archive changes under VERSIONS/.
pyproject.toml declares version 0.3.0 while src/file_uncorrupter/__init__.py exposes __version__ = "0.2.0".
pytest is configured but not declared as a package dependency.
FFmpeg/ffprobe-dependent behavior and tests depend on local tool availability.
Historical reports and release artifacts are evidence, not current implementation truth.
No deployment workflow is documented in this repo.
